It is a franchisor that, under a sublicense from Century 21 Real Estate LLC (International Headquarters) in the United States for the 'Century 21 marks, etc.' and the 'Century 21 System' it developed, operates real estate brokerage franchises in Japan. Operating revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,300 million, and the number of franchised stores at year-end was 934.
entries.25503ef50488efe8: To expand its store network, the company is recruiting franchisees. Franchised stores operate in the Tokyo metropolitan area, the Kansai area, the Chubu area, the Kyushu area and Hokkaido.
entries.2858376ccfe6a95a: It states that the core of corporate value is the “CENTURY 21” brand, and positions improving brand value as its greatest mission. Its basic medium- to long-term management strategy is to pursue two pillars: “expanding the CENTURY 21 network” and “management support for franchisee growth.” It also states that it will work to strengthen existing operations through capital alliances and business investments with companies that contribute to franchisee growth, and to strengthen real estate inbound business using its international network.
